# Knowlton Lab

> Research and teaching in biostatistics, machine learning and translational biomedical science, led by Dr Nicholas (Nick) Knowlton, affiliated with Massey University and the University of Auckland in Aotearoa New Zealand.

## Research and lab
- [Home](https://knowlton.co.nz/): Overview of Knowlton Lab.
- [About](https://knowlton.co.nz/about/): Approach and affiliations.
- [Research](https://knowlton.co.nz/research/): Breast cancer, reproductive AI and reproducibility.
- [People](https://knowlton.co.nz/students/): Students and research areas.
- [Publications](https://knowlton.co.nz/publications/): Selected publications.
- [Join](https://knowlton.co.nz/join/): Intake and contact information.
